extracted.name: Pea purée
extracted.description: Make this pea purée in a blender and enjoy alongside your favourite mains. It's simple to make with just three ingredients: frozen peas, double cream and mint
ingredient_lines: small handful of mint leaves roughly chopped (optional)
instruction_lines: Put everything in a high-powered blender with a good crack of black pepper and a pinch of salt. Blend until smooth. If you want to make it extra-smooth, strain through a sieve. Season to taste, if needed.
